redirect_uris.description: [Redirect URIs](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc6749#section-3.1.2) for the authorization endpoint. At least one is required.

client_name.description: Name shown to the User on the authorization page. Proof generates one when this is absent.

client_uri.description: URL of the client home page.

logo_uri.description: URL of a logo for the client.

contacts.description: Email addresses of people responsible for the client.

tos_uri.description: URL of the terms of service of the client.

policy_uri.description: URL of the privacy policy of the client.

jwks_uri.description: URL of the [JWK Set](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7517#section-5) of the client. Supply either `jwks_uri` or `jwks`.

jwks.description: The [JWK Set](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7517#section-5) of the client, by value. Supply either `jwks` or `jwks_uri`.

software_id.description: Identifier the client developer assigns to the client software.

token_endpoint_auth_method.description: Requested client authentication method. `private_key_jwt` requires `jwks` or `jwks_uri` and issues no `client_secret`; any other value results in `client_secret_post`.
